messages:
maria_ops: Heads up - eu-west-2 edge pool is down to 1x H100 available (two failed in last 48h). This is impacting low-latency customers. I pinged the vendor earlier - they have an RMA backlog. Need options: loaner, air-expedite, or re-route. What do we want to do?
javier_logistics: Vendor replied: RMA backlog 8-12 days for full replacements. They have a limited loaner pool but would charge an airlift fee + brokerage. Said they can do a 4-day air expedite if we cover courier + customs.
priya_procure: How much is the air-expedite surcharge? We need numbers to approve budget. Also: will vendor accept return of DOA units later or charge us if they don't get serials?
anil_infra: Short term can we move this workload to larger-hosted instances? Perf would degrade on 4096-token traces but keeps customers online. We should evaluate QoS > cost tradeoff.
nora_sre: Side note - two failed H100s show similar GPU ECC warnings before power loss. I'm running a quick thermal log grep now; could be datacenter cooling hitting hot spots. If it's environmental, replacements won't fix recurrence.
maria_ops: Copy. From vendor (quoted): "Airlift expedite 96h, courier fee €1,600, brokerage & customs handling estimate €900, loaner pool availability subject to manifest & HS code verification. RMA backlog 8-12d for permanent replacements."
javier_logistics: If we go air-expedite we'll need AWB, commercial invoice, and HS code. Recommend HS code 8471.80 (confirm with customs), and to prepay brokerage to avoid delays. Crossdock at FRA hub possible to save 24h.
priya_procure: Ballpark total = €2.5k per expedited unit. Approveable under emergency fund if we confirm impact. If vendor can provide loaner for free for 7d it's cheaper - ask for loaner holdback vs deposit.
anil_infra: Temporary config: reduce kv-cache size and move longer contexts to host-based rerank path to reduce memory. If we can shift 20% of traffic, we can survive until RMA. Not ideal but reduces immediate cost.
maria_ops: @javier can you ask vendor for explicit loaner terms (deposit amount, SLA credits, serial return window) and an AWB ETA if we sign now? Also ask if they can drop off to FRA crossdock.
javier_logistics: On it. Pinged vendor contact (internal note). Expected reply in 30-90m.
shipbot: Shipment proposal created: AWB 854-CRT-992 (provisional), service: air-express, est transit 96h, status: quote pending.
priya_procure: If vendor requires deposit, request invoice with CC terms and a commit that deposit is refundable on return in working condition. Also request SLA credit for capacity loss >5% while on loaner.
maria_ops: Agreed. Nora, continue thermal debug and share earliest log snippet. Anil, work with infra to prep config changes described. Priya/javier - prioritize vendor loaner terms first, then air-expedite quote.
nora_sre: Sharing quick grep: `dmesg | grep -i ecc` shows repeated corrected ECC events 2026-03-20 03:12 and 03:36. Attaching to ticket. If cooling is the cause we should hold off permanent swap until we check rack airflow.
priya_procure: Vendor replied: "Loaner: free for up to 7 days if RMAs processed within 14d. Deposit €500/unit refundable. Air-expedite: €1,600 courier + €850 brokerage + customs pre-clear €150. Can ship to FRA crossdock but requires manifest 24h prior."
javier_logistics: Vendor also says loaner pool is limited - if we request now they can reserve but we must confirm by EOD.
anil_infra: I can implement the config changes in 2h to shift traffic. Will coordinate a canary for the latency-sensitive route.
maria_ops: Decision: reserve loaner now and request the air-expedite quote as fallback. Priya - please approve the €500 deposit cap and emergency air budget up to €3k/unit. Javier - reserve loaner and get manifest/AWB ready. Nora/Anil - proceed with diag + mitigations. I'll update CS and impacted customers. :thumbsup:
